overview_description.description:
Pyxai is a software company that creates HR software that screens and ranks job applicants for qualifications, soft skills, and culture fit using information not available on applicant resumes. 

By screening all applicants, Pyxai helps companies eliminate unintended biases in the hiring process and identifies talent that would otherwise be overlooked. We do this by using AI to screen every applicant with open-ended, situational judgement tests. Identifying and extracting soft skills like communication, critical thinking, and grit provides holistic insight into an applicant and is a better indicator of long-term job success. 

The company is based in Boston, Massachusetts US.
